note: Separate proposal paragraphs include rationale; factual background is unlabelled.
text:
I suggest a five-minute response cache. This avoids repeated requests while keeping the data reasonably fresh.

I also recommend recording latency before rollout. Compare p95 after enabling the cache so that a regression is visible.

The existing API is stateless and runs on three workers.
